# E0422: a view outlives its source

The view reads a local that is gone when the function returns. Return a value of its own, or view a parameter instead.

- Rule: [`views.escaping`](../../reference/13-modes.md#views.escaping)
- Reported at: the expression that makes the view escape: the value returned, or the closure literal that captures it.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0422:6
use std.view

fn rest(xs: List<i64>) -> view.View<List<i64>> {
  let ys = xs.slice(1, xs.len())
  let v = view.View.all(ys)
  v
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn rest(xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> {
  xs.slice(1, xs.len())
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0422_a_view_outlives_its_source.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0422_a_view_outlives_its_source.lt):

```text
── A VIEW OUTLIVES ITS SOURCE ── E0422_a_view_outlives_its_source.lt:6:3  [E0422]

This view is returned, but it views `ys`, a local of this function:

  5 │   let v = view.View.all(ys)
    │       ─ `v` views `ys` from here
  6 │   v
    │   ^

The view reads a local that is gone when the function returns. Return a value of
its own, or view a parameter instead.
```
